app: isolated packaged macOS App with its own Core and data directory
runtimeFixtureScope: Controlled ACP frames through a temporary ROVAI_QWEN_BIN override; not evidence of Qwen Provider Usage or Context support

run.streamPattern: 14 text increments at 500 ms, tool call and 6000 ms silence, 10 text increments at 500 ms, terminal marker

expectation.midstreamOpen: Prior text establishes a baseline; only new text can produce speed after warmup
expectation.liveDisplay: Speed and duration occupy one line; speed text updates at most once per second
expectation.toolPause: Speed expires to unknown after five seconds with no new public text
expectation.resume: Speed restarts from new public text
expectation.history: Historical Run card has no current speed while the active Run card keeps its own speed
expectation.terminal: The current speed disappears immediately when the Run becomes terminal
expectation.lateUsage: A summary written after terminal becomes visible through continued polling without restarting the App

lateUsageMethod: After the real controlled Run reached succeeded, the acceptance script updated its existing empty runtime_usage_run_summary row. The App stayed open and its monitoring.execution terminal poll read the row. This tests the read and Renderer race, not native Qwen Usage emission.
